name: daily-motivation
description: Daily motivation YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels, built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render LaidOff20Years out/layoff/.raw-laid-off-20-years.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-laid-off-20-years.mp4 out/layoff/laid-off-20-years.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.render:short: remotion render LaidOffShort out/layoff/.raw-laid-off-short.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-laid-off-short.mp4 out/layoff/laid-off-short.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.covers: remotion still CoverVertical out/layoff/cover-9x16.png && remotion still ThumbWide out/layoff/thumbnail-16x9.png
scripts.brand: remotion still BrandAvatarFace brand/pencilstories-avatar-face.png && remotion still BrandAvatarIcon brand/pencilstories-avatar-icon.png && remotion still BrandBanner brand/pencilstories-youtube-banner.png && remotion still BrandWordmark brand/pencilstories-wordmark.png --image-format=png && remotion still BrandWatermark brand/pencilstories-youtube-watermark.png --image-format=png
